prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Waiting screen enhancements (wait_info) can be helpful, producing significant gains in two tests (+5.0% and +5.7%), though two tests showed no clear effect.
Adding new screens (new_screen) can be helpful, winning two tests (+15.4% and +6.4%), though one test significantly hurt performance (-7.7%).
Copy adjustments (copy), layout changes (layout), sign-in reordering (reorder), redesigns (redesign), and hints (hint) showed no clear effect across all tests.
Predictions underestimated large wins, such as the pet preview screen (+3.0% predicted vs +15.4% measured) and sound selection screen (+4.0% predicted vs +6.4% measured).
Predictions were generally too high for changes that showed no clear effect or resulted in a loss (e.g., predicting +15.4% for the quiz screen which measured -7.7%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.5% over 1 test(s)
- adoption, new_screen: +4.7% over 3 test(s)
- choose_path, hint: -2.2% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -1.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, redesign: +1.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +0.1% over 1 test(s)
- finish, hint: +5.6% over 1 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -3.0% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +3.4% over 4 test(s)
- sign_in, copy: +1.8% over 2 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.1% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 74.8%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 88.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_screen] Companion Behavior Audio Teaser Screen: Adds an interactive audio preview screen right before adoption certificate where users can sample reaction sounds. (why: Adding new screens during adoption setup has yielded strong historical conversion gains (+6.4% and +15.4%).)
1: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery and Sync Security Banner: Adds an explicit data sync and recovery hint on the sign in screen clarifying how existing pets stay saved. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
2: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Pet Care Quiz Screen: Inserts a companion preference quiz screen before path selection to help users select their ideal interaction style. (why: Adding targeted new screens in early onboarding steps has historically boosted funnel progression.)
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Companion Habit & Routine Scheduler Screen: Adds a daily pet activity scheduling screen while waiting for the background engine to complete setup. (why: Enhancing the waiting period with active setup screens increases retention and reduces perceived wait duration.)
4: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Quality Checklist and Validation: Switches photo upload layout to checklist format with lighting and framing guidelines for custom pet creation. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted custom pets.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Visibility Troubleshooting Checklist: Adds a display permission hint component to the waiting screen explaining desktop overlay permissions. (why: 3 support tickets noted that the pet failed to render on the desktop or the app stalled at startup.)
6: [choose_path, reorder] Pet Playtime Animation Preview on Story Screen: Reorganizes the story screen using a story_scroll layout featuring playfulness animations. (why: choose_path step has high mean duration (514s) and a drop-off rate of 23.8%; stronger initial storytelling improves early retention.)
7: [finish, hint] Quick Interaction Cheat Sheet Card: Adds a desktop right-click shortcut hint card on the home intro screen. (why: Multiple support emails asked how to control, minimize, or talk to their pet after onboarding finished.)

Home step has lower drop-off; complex new screen requires full release.
Supported by 3 tickets, but layout changes historically show little effect.

Reordering screens showed no clear effect across previous tests.
